prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_CWT_rf leads in seasonality capture (0.4131). The overall RMSE champion is rf (0.8543), but rankings are highly unstable (Kendall τ=-0.1813) with concept drift detected. Given unstable rankings and autocorrelated residuals across most models, a robust median or trimmed mean combiner is preferred over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
